canonicalRecord.canonicalName: Cadillac WWTP CWSRF Project Plan and Funding Proposal.pdf

verifiedFindings: The February 2, 2026 Council communication says the wastewater treatment plant had postponed several needed upgrades and consolidated them into one Capital Improvement Program project.
The engineering proposal describes the existing headworks as constructed in the 1960s, with aging and inefficient equipment and a building in poor condition.
The proposal says the 18- to 23-year-old UV disinfection system had recurring pneumatic-wiper, UV-intensity-meter and individual-bank-control problems.
The proposal says one primary clarifier was being used as a waste-activated-sludge holding tank, reducing available primary-settling capacity.
The proposed project plan included evaluation of current infrastructure performance, regulatory-compliance status and projected 20-year capacity and treatment requirements.
evidentiaryBoundary: The proposal supplies contemporaneous infrastructure context for evaluating separate April 2026 bypass records. It does not itself establish that any listed condition caused a bypass, identify a selected final construction project, or prove funding approval or completed construction.

queueResolution.reason: The proposal is infrastructure-planning evidence and does not supply the remaining delivery, laboratory, receptor, well-construction, groundwater-flow or synchronized source-to-receptor data.
